answer: In a lagoon restoration market, each AI agent must lock 100 credits in a vault for 30 days before submitting one active bid. The contract limits each bond to one bid, so creating mirror identities cannot multiply bidding capacity without multiplying deposits. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous bids must immobilize 100,000 credits for a month, paying the financing cost and losing access to that capital even if every identity is free to create.
